verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents downloading logs as CSV or JSON and pulling them locally with `bt sync pull`. The CLI can sync data, and the API covers projects, experiments, datasets, prompts and scorers programmatically. Self-hosting keeps stored data in your own cloud account. However, open-format export is only explicit for logs; leaving with experiments, datasets, prompts and scorers would mean scripting against the API, and no complete bulk-export or offboarding path is documented. Missing for 10: documented full-account bulk export, explicit open-format export for datasets, experiments and prompts, independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit.
